interpretation.label: e2_world_forward_sleep_trainer_live
interpretation.combination_rule: PASS iff ALL of C1..C6 pass (plain AND, no OR/any() branching). The frozen-battery efficacy readouts are UNGATED and route no verdict.

preconditions.name: ARM_WORLD_FORWARD_ON:42:world_replay_pairs_populated
preconditions.control: real waking rollout via _e1_tick, not synthetic buffers

preconditions.name: ARM_WORLD_FORWARD_ON:42:world_loss_non_sentinel
preconditions.control: probed on the same real buffers the sleep cycle draws from

preconditions.name: ARM_WORLD_FORWARD_ON:42:world_grad_nonzero
preconditions.control: backward() from the realised world loss onto the two world heads

preconditions.name: ARM_WORLD_FORWARD_ON:42:world_param_scoping_one_directional
preconditions.control: the e2_world set must contain NO non-world e2 parameter (the build's actual guarantee; the e2 list is a SUPERSET, so literal disjointness is false by construction)

preconditions.name: ARM_WORLD_FORWARD_ON:42:action_buffer_non_vacuous
preconditions.control: agent.e1_action_buffer_stats(), the substrate's own non-vacuity detector for this failure mode

preconditions.name: ARM_WORLD_FORWARD_ON:42:frozen_battery_populated
preconditions.control: held-out env (seed+9973) + fixed action policy, pure read

preconditions.name: ARM_WORLD_FORWARD_ON:42:sleep_cycle_fired
preconditions.control: post_sleep_z_goal_retention is merged unconditionally at the end of _run_cycle
